concept: Respecting people who hold genuinely different views within the same community
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student encounters a peer with a genuinely different opinion on a low-stakes community issue
exercise.branching_choice: Student navigates the disagreement while remaining part of the same community/group
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what it means to disagree well, without dismissing the other person

assessment.success_marker: student can restate the other view accurately and respectfully, even while disagreeing
